blocks.text: Shared feasts and thoughtful gifts take center stage as City of Dreams Manila marks the Mid-Autumn Festival with Crystal Dragon’s special à la carte menu and Café Society’s elegantly boxed mooncakes. Crystal Dragon’s Mid-Autumn Festival menu At Crystal Dragon, Chef de Cuisine Chan Choo Kean presents a festive menu showcasing premium ingredients, refined flavors and craftsmanship. Available from September 21 to 30 for lunch and dinner, the selection invites families and friends to gather in the spirit of harmony and abundance. Situated at the Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Nuwa Manila, Crystal Dragon is known for Cantonese cuisine and regional Chinese specialties […]...
